plugins.description: Connector cards: a connected app's own UI in the chat, for any connector. One tool call per ask; the plugin reads and writes the app itself through Bonsai's sign-in, and Jev picks the connector, the view and the fields at runtime. Linear and Google Calendar today; a scaffold adds more.
